Filing Party/Contacts:

Filing Party                             Signer (Representative)                  Other Contact (Principal)               
------------                             -----------------------                  -------------------------               
Oklahoma Gas and Electric Company        sultemwh@oge.com                         snodgrcc@oge.com                        

Basis for Intervening:
Pursuant to Rules 212 and 214 of the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission’s (“Commission”) Rules of Practice and Procedure, 18 C.F.R. § 385.212, 214, Oklahoma Gas & Electric Company (“OG&E”) respectfully moves to intervene in the above captioned proceeding.

OG&E is a multistate electric utility providing electric service at retail and wholesale in Oklahoma and Arkansas.  OG&E is a transmission, generation, and distribution owning member of the Southwest Power Pool, Inc. (“SPP”) serving customers in Oklahoma and Arkansas.

Pursuant to the requirements of the Commission and the SPP Open Access Transmission Tariff (“SPP Tariff”), OG&E has ceded functional control of its transmission facilities to SPP.  Further, OG&E is a transmission customer under the SPP Tariff and participates in the markets administered by SPP.

As transmission owner, transmission customer, and market participant within SPP, OG&E would be directly affected by any decision in this docket. Therefore OG&E has an interest in this proceeding that cannot adequately be represented by any other party, and the Commission should grant this motion to intervene.
